fullPassage: Gregg and I had been rock climbing since sunrise and had had no problems. So we took a risk. "Look, the first bolt is right there. I can definitely climb out to it. Piece of cake," I persuaded Gregg, minutes before I found myself pinned. It wasn't a piece of cake. The rock was deceptively barren of handholds. I clumsily moved back and forth across the cliff face and ended up with nowhere to go... but down. The bolt that would save my life, if I could get to it, was about two feet above my reach. My arms trembled from exhaustion. I looked at Gregg. My body froze with fright from my neck down to my toes. Our rope was tied between us. If I fell, he would fall with me.

나는 분명히 그것까지 기어올라 갈 수 있다.

[조건] (1) can, climb, definitely, I, it, out, to를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: I can definitely climb out to it
det.analysis:
본문: 'I can definitely climb out to it' — 조동사 can + 부사 definitely + 동사원형 climb

[조건 검증] I(1) can(2) definitely(3) climb(4) out(5) to(6) it(7) = 7단어
det.tip: can + 부사(definitely) + 동사원형

questions.wa: I can definitely climb out to it
accept: I can definitely climb out to it

questions.passage: I can definitely climb out to it. "Piece of cake," I __________ (persuade) Gregg, minutes before I found myself pinned. It wasn't a piece of cake. The rock was deceptively barren of handholds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: persuaded (설득했다)
det.analysis: persuade → persuaded: 전체 이야기가 과거 시제이므로 과거형 persuaded
det.tip: 과거형: persuade → persuaded

questions.passage: Gregg and I had been rock climbing since sunrise and had had no problems. So we took a risk. "Look, the first bolt is right there. I can definitely climb out to it. Piece of cake," I persuaded Gregg, minutes before I found myself pinned. It wasn't a piece of cake. The rock was deceptively barren of handholds. I clumsily moved back and forth across the cliff face and ended up with nowhere to go... but down. The bolt that would save my life, __________, was about two feet above my reach. My arms trembled from exhaustion. I looked at Gregg. My body froze with fright from my neck down to my toes. Our rope was tied between us. If I fell, he would fall with me.

det.korean: I clumsily moved back and forth across the cliff face

본문: 'I clumsily moved back and forth across the cliff face and ended up ~' — 주어 I + 부사 clumsily + 과거동사 moved + back and forth(앞뒤로) + across the cliff face

어순: I + clumsily + moved + back and forth + across the cliff face
det.tip: back and forth = 앞뒤로 / across = ~을 가로질러
